elsewhere.note: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster…
Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
